verses.51:29: فَأَقۡبَلَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ فِي صَرَّةࣲ فَصَكَّتۡ وَجۡهَهَا وَقَالَتۡ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمࣱ‏

meaning: The root صكك primarily means to strike or hit something hard, often producing a sound. It can also refer to striking with the palm of the hand or to a loud, clashing sound.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
